components.css: .ds-marks { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; align-items: center; font-family: 'Inter Tight', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-mark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #111; } .ds-mark::before { content: ''; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-issued::before { background: var(--green, #00843d); } .ds-pending::before { background: #fff; border: 3px solid #111; } .ds-failed { color: var(--red-ink, #b10016); } .ds-failed::before { width: 14px; border-radius: 0; background: var(--red-ink, #b10016); clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-deleted { color: #626260; text-decoration: line-through; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-deleted::before { background: #fff; border: 2px solid #626260; } .ds-tag-dry { display: inline-flex; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; background: #fff; color: #111; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #111; }

components.css: .ds-line { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(6, minmax(0, 1fr)); list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: 'Inter Tight', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-line::before, .ds-line::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 10px; height: 8px; left: calc(100% / 12); } .ds-line::before { right: calc(100% / 12); background: #e8e7e3; } .ds-line::after { width: calc((100% - 100% / 6) * var(--progress, 0)); background: #e3001b; } .ds-stop { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: #626260; } .ds-dot { width: 28px; height: 28px; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; border: 6px solid #e8e7e3; } .ds-stop.done { color: #3f3f3d; } .ds-stop.done .ds-dot { border-color: #e3001b; } .ds-stop.current { color: #111; font-weight: 700; } .ds-stop.current .ds-dot { background: #e3001b; border-color: #e3001b; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #fff, 0 0 0 6px #e3001b; }

narrative.overview:
The interface is a Milan metro map of the instance, in the Noorda/Unimark and Olivetti tradition: white ground, a solid signal-red rail, near-black ink, bold tight grotesque type and 2px black rules between sections. Each project is a line whose six stations are its setup steps, and the home page is one line from `git clone` to the first live invoice. The metro line is the system's reusable signature; everything else stays quiet so the line and the statuses read first.

Density is that of an operations panel read by accountants as well as developers: generous row padding (24px project rows, 14px table cells), plain-language status words always next to their marks, and no decoration that is not a wayfinding device. The scene is a daylight office, so the system is light only (`color-scheme: light`); there is no dark theme.

The world rejects the category default it was built against: grey sidebar, white cards, pastel status pills. Depth comes from rules and flat warm-grey fields, never from cards or soft shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Signal-red rail and brand, near-black ink, warm-grey fields, square corners everywhere except station dots.
2px black rules as the section divider; 1px hairlines inside lists and tables.
Inter Tight at 800 for every heading; JetBrains Mono 500 for keys, commands and code.
State carried by metro marks (filled green dot, hollow ink ring, red-ink triangle), always with a word.

rules.name: The Red Is Not An Error Rule
rules.body: Signal red is the brand and the rail. Errors use red ink plus a mark (triangle, dashed ring or alert icon) plus words, never colour alone and never signal red.

rules.name: The End Of The Line Rule
rules.body: Green appears only for live and issued (and the success check). Dry run and pending are never green.

rules.name: The No Wash Rule
rules.body: There are no tinted or pastel backgrounds. Every notice, the confirm box and the key reveal sit on warm grey (`field`) and are told apart by their top rule: ink by default, red ink for errors and confirmations, signal red for the key reveal.

rules.name: The Heavy Or Plain Rule
rules.body: Headings are 800; body is 400; labels and controls are 600 to 700. No light display weights.

rules.name: The Copy Is Mono Rule
rules.body: Anything a reader copies or types into a terminal (API key, command, request, slug) is JetBrains Mono.

rules.name: The Stacked Row Rule
rules.body: Below 640px, invoice tables stop being tables: each row becomes a two-column grid placed by `data-col` (number left, status top right, amount right, project/customer/created below in ink-2, details and actions full width), separated by 2px rules.

rules.name: The Ruled Not Raised Rule
rules.body: Separate with a rule or a field, never with a card or shadow.

dos: **Do** divide sections with a 2px ink rule and list items with a 1px hair.
**Do** pair every status colour with a mark shape and a plain word.
**Do** keep notices, confirmations and the key reveal on `field` and distinguish them by their top rule.
**Do** derive any setup line from stored project fields, six stations, from Created to Live.
**Do** set `color-scheme: light` and design for daylight only.
**Do** keep corners square; reserve round forms for stations and status dots.
donts: **Don't** use signal red for errors or failure; use red ink with a mark.
**Don't** use green for dry run, pending or anything that is not live or issued.
**Don't** use tinted or pastel washes for notices or statuses.
**Don't** use cards, rounded corners or drop shadows for separation.
